review_candidates.title: Quality Assurance Manager
review_candidates.description: We are looking for an experienced and meticulous Quality Assurance Manager to join our client in Dubai. The primary focus of this role is to ensure that every project in the construction and fit-out industry adheres to our strict brand guidelines, quality standards, and specifications. The successful candidate will implement robust quality control processes that guarantee cost-cutting measures never result in sub-par quality, protecting our reputation for excellence and delivering consistently outstanding project outcomes that is the basis of our brand promise. This is a critical role that requires deep expertise in construction and fit-out quality management, a sharp eye for detail, the ability to enforce uncompromising standards across all project phases while collaborating effectively with project teams, contractors, consultants, and clients and the capacity to understand and adhere to the DNA of our brands, and strong commercial awareness. Key responsibilities Ensure quality adherence Develop, implement, and continuously improve comprehensive quality assurance systems, processes, and checklists tailored to construction and fit-out projects. Ensure every project strictly adheres to company brand guidelines, approved design specifications, material standards, and finish requirements from concept through handover. Actively monitor and control cost-saving and value-engineering measures to ensure they do not compromise quality, workmanship, durability, or brand promise to customers. Oversee execution quality on site Conduct systematic site inspections, quality audits, and progressive checks at key stages of construction and fit-out works to identify defects early and prevent rework. Review and approve materials, mock-ups, samples, workmanship, and finishes against approved benchmarks, drawings, and brand standards before installation or sign-off. Cross-functional quality management Collaborate closely with project managers, site engineers, contractors, consultants, and internal design/operations teams to uphold quality without delaying delivery. Represent the company in quality-related meetings with clients, consultants, authorities, and at project progress reviews as required. Reporting Issue quality reports, lead root-cause analysis, and drive timely corrective and preventive actions with both internal project teams and external subcontractors. Prepare clear, professional quality reports, inspection records, snag lists, and handover documentation that meet client and company requirements. Maintain accurate, auditable quality documentation, photographic records, and digital archives for all projects. Champion the quality and brand ethos across the organization Lead quality induction, toolbox talks, and training sessions for site teams and subcontractors to embed a culture of quality and brand compliance. Requirements Proven track record of delivering QA/QC on complex or high-specification residential, commercial, hospitality, or retail fit-out projects where brand standards and finish quality are non-negotiable for high-end projects and brands. Demonstrable experience ensuring cost-control and value-engineering measures never result in compromised quality, materials, or workmanship. In-depth knowledge of brand guideline enforcement, material and finish specifications, mock-up approvals, snagging processes, and client handover standards in fit-out projects. Strong commercial acumen with the ability to understand project budgets, tender specifications, and the commercial impact of quality decisions. Excellent inspection, auditing, analytical, and problem-solving skills with a zero-tolerance mindset for sub-standard work. Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills; able to influence contractors, site teams, and stakeholders while maintaining professional relationships. Proficiency in quality management systems, inspection tools, and project documentation platforms. Valid UAE driving license preferred (frequent site visits required). Qualifications & Experience Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, Building Surveying, or a related discipline. Professional certifications in Quality Management are highly desirable. Minimum 6-8 years of progressive experience in Quality Assurance / Quality Control within the construction, fit-out, or high-end interior fit-out industry, preferably in the UAE (Dubai experience strongly preferred). Key skills & competencies Quality management systems, ISO 9001, and construction QA/QC best practices Strict brand guideline and specification compliance Construction and high-end fit-out quality control (materials, finishes, workmanship, detailing) Cost-quality balance and oversight of value engineering without quality loss Site inspection, auditing, snagging, and non-conformance management Cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder influence Clear technical report writing and documentation excellence Exceptional attention to detail and uncompromising commitment to quality Knowledge of UAE construction regulations, local market practices, and industry standards

review_candidates.title: Projectmanager Civiele Constructies
review_candidates.description: Jij houdt het overzicht waar anderen afhaken Of het nu gaat om een beweegbare brug, een waterkering of een megaproject als de Zeesluis van IJmuiden: jij weet hoe je een civiel project van A tot Z goed laat verlopen. Als projectmanager civiele constructies bij Iv ben jij degene die de lijnen uitzet, het team scherp houdt en zorgt dat alles – écht alles – klopt. Techniek, planning, budget, stakeholders: jij hebt het onder controle. Je stuurt projectteams aan en zorgt dat de inhoud, planning en uitvoering op rolletjes lopen. Anders dan een projectleider voer jij deze rol multidisciplinair uit over al onze civiele disciplines. Denk aan projecten waarin constructieve waterbouw, beton- en staalconstructies, instandhouding en monitoring samenkomen. Als de projectmanager civiele constructies zorg je dat iedereen weet wat er moet gebeuren én wanneer. Je houdt de vaart erin, zonder de kwaliteit uit het oog te verliezen. Met opdrachtgevers bouw je aan langdurige relaties door eerlijk, duidelijk en betrouwbaar te zijn. En je zorgt dat de veiligheid en kwaliteit op topniveau blijven tot het laatste detail in het project. Je komt als projectmanager civiele constructies bij Iv terecht in een club bevlogen engineers, adviseurs en specialisten die met veel passie werken aan technisch uitdagende vraagstukken. Afhankelijk van het project verschilt de samenstelling van het team die je aanstuurt. Binnen Iv zijn de lijnen kort en de samenwerking sterk dankzij de verspreide en diepgaande kennis binnen onze verschillende disciplines. Je rapporteert aan de directie van onze infradivisie. Wat verwachten we van jou? Een afgeronde technische hbo- of wo-opleiding Minimaal 10 jaar relevante werkervaring Uitstekende beheersing van zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal Sterk in leidinggeven, plannen en organiseren Doelgericht, communicatief en in staat om snel te schakelen tussen disciplines binnen Iv Wat hebben we jou te bieden? Een uitdagende en gevarieerde baan bij het meest diverse ingenieursbureau van Nederland! Zo kun je rekenen op: De gaafste projecten in alle sectoren: je werkt aan hoogwaardige oplossingen waar de maatschappij écht iets aan heeft. Iv werkt aan ’s werelds grootste offshore windplatformen, bruggen en sluizen tot fabrieken, waterzuiveringsinstallaties en onderzeeboten. Een professionele én gezellige werkomgeving: bij Iv vind je een laagdrempelige werksfeer waarin hard werken hand in hand gaat met plezier. Zo bezoeken we tweejaarlijks het EK- of WK-voetbal, vieren we nieuwjaar groots in de Efteling, organiseren we gezellige zomerbarbecues en nog veel meer! Flexibele arbeidsvoorwaarden: kies voor meer salaris, extra vakantiedagen of beide! Uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden: 31 vakantiedagen, jaarlijkse gratificatie (7%), winstuitkering, flexibele pensioenregeling en reiskosten- en thuiswerkvergoeding. Kortom: bij Iv werk je samen met 1400 andere specialisten aan de grootste uitdagingen van deze tijd én beleef je veel plezier. Dat noemen wij: engineering that excites.

review_candidates.description: Do you want to understand how to organise the transition to circular consumption of e-bikes, employing stakeholder workshops, scenarios, and pathways, and diving into circular consumption ecosystems? Job Description If this question sparks your interest and you are motivated to pursue a PhD in circular consumption niches and the transition to circular consumption, you might be our new colleague for the Circular Consumption through Value-Chain Integration and Co-Creation for the Circular Economy (CIVIC-4CE) project. We are seeking an excellent candidate for a 4-year PhD study as part of the CIVIC-4CE project, an interdisciplinary and transdisciplinary research project funded by NWO, the Netherlands Research Council, under the call on KIC Consumer behaviour for a circular system transition. See: https://www.tudelft.nl/en/2026/tbm/tpm-researchers-receive-nwo-kic-consumer-behaviour-for-a-circular-system-transition-grant. The project includes 2 PhD positions, 2 Postdoc positions, and several researchers at Universities of Applied Sciences. CIVIC-4CE studies how changing consumer behaviour can accelerate the Dutch transition to a circular society. The project focuses on how changing circular consumption contributes to extending product lifetime, retaining material value, and reducing waste, with cases on e-bikes and electronics (washing machines). Using a transdisciplinary research approach that includes stakeholder engagement, behavioural science, design research, transition studies, and modelling, the project aims to develop empirically grounded interventions and governance strategies that enable lasting behavioural change towards circular consumption. Within this PhD vacancy, you will work in the work package that focuses on systemic transitions towards circular consumption and production through integrating behavioural change, visions and transition pathways, modelling, and policy mixes. The work combines qualitative and quantitative methods, including stakeholder workshops, interviews, backcasting, transition pathways, policy mixes, social simulation modelling, and possibly participatory value evaluation or gamification. You will collaborate with other early-career and senior researchers in the project, as well as other consortium partners. You will also reach out to relevant stakeholders, innovating companies, and policymakers to gather data and validate results. Your main supervisors will be Assistant Professor Jaco Quist and Associate Professor Emile Chappin. Job Requirements The following further qualifications will be considered in the assessment, while the profile of the candidate will be taken into account for developing the direction of the research: Documented experiences and skills in one or several types of methods, e.g., qualitative research, participatory research, quantitative socio-technical modelling. Strong background and interest in the transition to a circular economy, circular innovation ecosystems, circular/sustainable consumption and participatory approaches. Ability to thrive in an interdisciplinary and technical environment. Excellent writing, presenting, and communication skills. Open-minded team player, able to work in multidisciplinary teams and to collaborate with stakeholders. The working language in the project is English, so the candidate must have strong skills in both written and spoken English, while sufficient proficiency in Dutch is considered an advantage for stakeholder interactions and research into relevant circular consumption niches. TU Delft (Delft University of Technology) Working at TU Delft means contributing to solutions that really make a difference. For over 180 years, we have been training engineers who make an impact worldwide in companies, government bodies, or as entrepreneurs. Our alumni turn knowledge into concrete solutions for the challenges of today and tomorrow. These challenges are changing rapidly. That is why we focus on themes such as energy, climate, digitalisation, artificial intelligence (AI), and smart mobility every day. Our education and research are directly aligned with what society needs now and in the future. At TU Delft, our people make the difference. With their knowledge and curiosity, our staff provide a high-quality education and conduct pioneering research that extends beyond the campus. You will have the opportunity to take the initiative, work with others, and grow as a professional. Working at TU Delft means join an international community of professionals and students. Together, we create knowledge, innovations, and solutions that help move the world forward. Faculty Technology, Policy & Management The Faculty of TPM provides an important contribution to solving complex technical-social issues, such as energy transition, mobility, digitalisation, water management and (cyber) security. TPM does this with its excellent education and research at the intersection of technology, society and policy. We combine insights from both engineering and social sciences as well as the humanities. TPM develops robust models and designs, is internationally oriented and has an extensive network of knowledge institutions, companies, social organisations and governments. Click here to go to the website of the Faculty of Technology, Policy and Management. Conditions of employment Doctoral candidates will be offered a 4-year period of employment in principle, but in the form of 2 employment contracts. An initial 1,5 year contract with an official go/no go progress assessment within 15 months. Followed by an additional contract for the remaining 2,5 years assuming everything goes well and performance requirements are met. Salary and benefits are in accordance with the Collective Labour Agreement for Dutch Universities, increasing from €3204 - €4051 gross per month, from the first year to the fourth year based on a fulltime contract (38 hours), plus 8% holiday allowance and an end-of-year bonus of 8.3%. As a PhD candidate you will be enrolled in the TU Delft Graduate School. The TU Delft Graduate School provides an inspiring research environment with an excellent team of supervisors, academic staff and a mentor. The Doctoral Education Programme is aimed at developing your transferable, discipline-related and research skills. The TU Delft offers a customisable compensation package, discounts on health insurance, and a monthly work costs contribution. Flexible work schedules can be arranged. Will you need to relocate to the Netherlands for this job? TU Delft is committed to make your move as smooth as possible! The HR unit, Coming to Delft Service, offers information on their website to help you prepare your relocation. In addition, Coming to Delft Service organises events to help you settle in the Netherlands, and expand your (social) network in Delft. A Dual Career Programme is available, to support your accompanying partner with their job search in the Netherlands. Additional Information For more information about this vacancy, you can contact Dr Jaco Quist (j.n.quist@tudelft.nl). Application procedure Are You Interested In This Vacancy? Please Apply No Later Than 30 September 2026 Via The Application Button And Upload The Following Documents CV, cover letter, BSc/MSc diploma (in English), and grade transcripts, including an official description of the grading scale The first round of interviews will take place on 7 and 9 October, and the second round of interviews is scheduled for 21 October 2026. A concise overview of the project and a description of the WP on “Systemic Transitions towards Circular Consumption and Production: Integrating Behavioural Change, Modelling, and Policy using stakeholder dialogue, pathways and backcasting” are available upon request. Candidates who are invited for an interview will be asked to submit two writing samples, e.g., a paper or a thesis. Candidates who are invited will be requested to prepare first ideas for the PhD project proposal (maximum 2 pages), including a possible research objective, theoretical framework, phases and intended methodological approach. If the applicants are selected for an interview, they will be asked to provide contact details of two referees with their consent. You can address your application to Dr Jaco Quist. Doing a PhD at TU Delft requires English proficiency at a certain level to ensure that the candidate is able to communicate and interact well, participate in English-taught Doctoral Education courses, and write scientific articles and a final thesis. For more details please check the Graduate Schools Admission Requirements. Please Note You can apply online. We will not process applications sent by email and/or post. When the outcome of the assessment is negative, the candidate will be informed. The processing of personal data in the context of the risk assessment is carried out on the legal basis of the GDPR: performing a public task in the public interest. You can find more information about this assessment on our website about knowledge security. Please do not contact us for unsolicited services.
